features.title: Features
features.summary: [REVIEW] Play to the music on two lanes with three kinds of notes, alongside characters who each bring an ability of their own. Collect and upgrade your team, with missions and events always waiting.

f1.title: [REVIEW] Two lanes, three kinds of notes
f1.text: [REVIEW] Notes come down two lanes, left and right, in time with the music. Tap them, hold them, or hit both lanes at once.

f2.title: [REVIEW] Every character plays differently
f2.text: [REVIEW] Each character has a passive of their own, such as keeping the combo after the first Miss or recovering HP at a steady pace.

f3.title: [REVIEW] Collect and upgrade
f3.text: [REVIEW] Get new characters from the gacha, then level them up and upgrade them to make them stronger.

f4.title: [REVIEW] Always something to play
f4.text: [REVIEW] Daily and weekly missions, limited-time events, a story campaign, and leaderboards checked by the server so rankings stay fair.

gameplay.title: Gameplay
gameplay.summary: [REVIEW] Hit the notes on the beat to keep your combo, fill Fever and reach the end of the song before your HP runs out. Between songs, collect new characters and complete daily missions.

g1.title: [REVIEW] Fight to the rhythm
g1.text: [REVIEW] Notes come down two lanes, and each hit is graded Perfect, Great or Hit; a note you miss is a Miss. Misses cost HP, so reach the end of the song before it runs out.

g2.title: [REVIEW] Combo and Fever
g2.text: [REVIEW] Hit notes without missing to build a combo. Good hits fill the Fever gauge; when it is full, Fever starts and your score climbs faster.

g3.title: [REVIEW] New characters from the gacha
g3.text: [REVIEW] New characters come from the gacha. After 30 pulls without a 5★ character, the next pull is guaranteed to be a 5★.

g4.title: [REVIEW] Missions and sign-in rewards
g4.text: [REVIEW] Complete daily and weekly missions, and collect monthly sign-in rewards.

amiya.passiveDescription: The first Miss of a run does not break the combo.

nova.passiveDescription: A Great has a chance to be counted as a Perfect.

echo.passiveDescription: A high combo extends how long Fever lasts.

pulse.passiveDescription: Recovers a little HP at a steady interval.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data Promuse collects when you pre-register with your Google account, how it is used, how long it is kept and how to ask for its deletion. You do not need to sign in to visit the website and view its content. Signing in is only needed if you want to join the pre-registration program to receive the reward.
privacy.storedHeading: What we store when you register
privacy.storedEmail: The email address of your Google account
privacy.storedGoogleId: Your Google account ID, used to identify your account and link your registration details (not your password)
privacy.storedLocale: The language you use when registering
privacy.why: Promuse uses this data to manage pre-registrations and to identify the right game account to receive the reward when the program is rolled out. Linking registrations to a Google account helps avoid mistakes in identifying who receives the reward.
privacy.processors: Supabase stores your sign-in account and your registration on servers in Tokyo, Japan. The sign-in account holds the email address, name and profile picture of your Google account, and when you signed in. Vercel runs the website. Google handles the sign-in and only tells the website your email address, name, profile picture and account ID, never your password.
privacy.retention: We keep the data until the pre-registration reward has been delivered to your game account, or until the project stops; then it is deleted. You can ask for earlier deletion at any time.
privacy.deletion:
You can ask for your registration data to be deleted at any time by emailing the address under Contact. To help us confirm that the account is yours, please send the request from the same Gmail address you registered with and state clearly that you want your data deleted.

Once we have verified the request, we will delete your sign-in account and the related registration details from Promuse's systems, and reply to confirm the result.

Note: once your data is deleted, we no longer have the information needed to identify you and send you the pre-registration reward.
privacy.contact: If you have any questions or requests about your personal data, please contact us by email: {email}.
